meta.title: Migrate from chokidar to @parcel/watcher
meta.body_summary: Migrate file watching in the RunManager from chokidar to @parcel/watcher for native file system performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin migrated chokidar to @parcel/watcher; PR closed manually with no substantive review or feedback; performance claim narrative-only.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 68 changed lines, this is a small edit by absolute volume. As a small-step dependency-swap performance PR it was closed—not merged—without any review engagement, which is unusual for low-risk library changes.

review_details.performance_claim: Improved file watching performance via native file system APIs with @parcel/watcher instead of chokidar.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed manually without comment or review; no explicit rejection signal in dataset.

maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no fix cycle.
